reuse.why: Takes its categories from getMonthFillCategories, the inclusion rule from isMonthFillCategory and the sign from toAverageFillAmount, exactly as the sibling month-wide actions do.

duplication.why: No logic is copied; the action only adds the previous-month sheet lookup that is specific to it.

placement.why: Defined in budget/actions.ts beside the other month-wide actions and registered in budget/app.ts with mutator(undoable(...)) like them.

scope.why: Only the new action, its registration and its tests.

maintainability.why: Follows the established month-fill pattern so any change to the category rules or sign applies automatically; the only nit is reusing a helper named for averages.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses the existing month-fill helpers throughout.
